The new, and first, Chair of the Board, Harvey Jones, shared news of Huang's resignation

items.title: Review: Delta Sees No Pushback on Higher Fares, CEO Says
items.summary: Delta Air Lines Inc.’s chief executive officer Ed Bastian says there's been no slowdown in demand even as ticket prices rise. “We haven’t seen the pushback,” he told Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz on Thursday. "It is supply and demand. The demand is really strong." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Nvidia’s $10 Billion Anthropic IPO Pledge in Focus With CEO Exit
items.summary: Anthropic PBC’s plans for a record initial public offering are under fresh scrutiny after Nvidia Corp.’s CEO was unexpectedly ousted, highlighting the links between the two artificial intelligence giants.
